name: Wind Buffets (1-2)
source: Pathfinder Society Quest #22: Friends in Need
description: The wind grows fierce as a small planar fissure opens, blowing around leaves and creatures alike.
disable: type:arcana,nature,thievery|dc:15 (trained) two times to counter the planar energies.
routine:
(3 actions) On its turn each round, the wind begins blowing fiercely from a random direction. All creatures must attempt a type:reflex|dc:15 save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is moved 5 feet in the direction the wind is blowing.

Failure The creature is moved 10 feet in the direction the wind is blowing and is knocked Prone.

Critical Failure The creature is moved 10 feet in the direction the wind is blowing, is knocked prone, and is Stunned 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: An Intense Gust!
offensiveAbilities.description:
A non-elemental creature approaches within 20 feet

Effect All creatures within 20 feet must attempt a type:reflex|dc:18 save; results are as if the hazard used its normal routine. The hazard then rolls initiative.
